[Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/mozambique_current_situation_fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2020]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2020 in Mozambique. The data represents spatial classifications of acute food insecurity phases across administrative units, capturing the severity and geographic distribution of food security crises driven primarily by drought conditions.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a monthly schedule to assess acute food insecurity severity and geographic extent.
